title: Warm Molten Indian Chicken Biryani
description: A jammy and molten Indian dish featuring massaman curry paste, this adventurous biryani is cooked to perfection in a bain-marie, making it a low-calorie-friendly option for dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, water, and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the bain-marie by filling a large bowl with hot water.
Add the basmati rice to a heatproof bowl and place it in the bain-marie, covering with a lid.
Cook the rice for 15 minutes, or until tender and fluffy.
To assemble the biryani, fluff the cooked rice with a fork and mix with the chicken and curry sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
